+ About

Hi, I'm Enoch.

Frontend developer & designer based in Accra, Ghana.

+ My story

I've liked making things since my first calculators and games. After SHS, I learned to code from YouTube tutorials, then started making websites for family and friends' businesses. That work grew into freelance projects.

I studied systems engineering at IPMC, explored AWS cloud engineering through an internship with EXL, and spent time learning data engineering with Data Engineer Academy. Those experiences helped me see that frontend development and design are where I want to focus.

Now I lead design at MadeBySebi and build web experiences for businesses, including Lucenex Corp. You can see more of my work on GitHub.

+ How I work

Start with the person

I try to understand what someone needs to do before deciding what the screen should look like.

Make the path clear

Good structure, readable content and straightforward interactions matter as much as the final visual polish.

Build for real use

I pay attention to the small screens, slow connections and edge cases a polished mockup can miss.

Keep improving

I test what I build, work through feedback and refine the details after the first version is live.

React · Next.js · TypeScript · JavaScript · Tailwind CSS · WordPress · Git
